登录用于跨设备同步听写历史、随记、录音和个人统计；未登录时数据保存在本机。: Sign in to sync dictation history, notes, note audio and personal stats across devices. Data stays local while signed out.

填写自行部署的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 服务端地址: Enter the HTTP or HTTPS address of your self-hosted server
填写自己的服务端地址，本机或内网地址也可以；留空表示未配置。: Enter your own server address, including local or private-network addresses. Blank means not configured.
用于设置、按钮和提示文字。: Language used for settings, buttons and messages.
选择浅色、深色或跟随系统。: Choose light, dark or the system setting.
在悬浮条中显示听写、翻译或问答模式。: Show the dictation, translation or Ask mode on the floating bar.
录音开始、结束或失败时播放提示音。: Play a sound when recording starts, ends or fails.
悬浮条提示自动隐藏前的等待时间，单位为秒。: Seconds before floating bar messages are hidden.
录音时静音系统播放，结束后恢复原有状态。: Mute system playback while recording and restore it afterwards.
减小音频上传体积；服务不支持时自动改用 WAV。: Reduce upload size; use WAV if the service does not support Opus.
开始测试后说话，检查音量指示是否有响应。: Start a test and speak to check the input level.
推荐自动模式，优先通过剪贴板粘贴。: Automatic mode is recommended and tries clipboard paste first.
在支持富文本的应用中保留粗体和列表。仅剪贴板模式可用。: Keep bold text and lists in supported apps. Requires clipboard insertion.
粘贴完成后还原剪贴板。仅剪贴板模式可用。: Restore clipboard contents after pasting. Requires clipboard insertion.
保存随记数据库和录音。更改目录不会迁移已有内容。: Stores notes and recordings. Changing folders does not move existing data.
打开设置、历史和日志所在的目录。: Open the folder containing settings, history and logs.
通用管理外观、启动与提示；语音与翻译管理语言和录音；文本输入管理插入与应用排除；: General covers appearance, startup and feedback. Speech and translation covers languages and recording. Text input covers insertion and excluded apps. Data and storage covers history and folders.
设置 → 数据与存储 →「历史记录上限」默认 500 条，超出自动删最旧。: Settings → Data and storage → History limit defaults to 500 records; the oldest are removed when full.
设置 → 数据与存储 →「用户数据总目录」可打开设置、历史和日志目录；随记目录在: Settings → Data and storage → User data folder opens settings, history and logs. The notes folder is configured separately on the same page.
设置、历史、录音和日志默认保存在本机；登录自行部署的服务端并启用同步后，可同步历: Settings, history, recordings and logs are stored locally by default. Sign in to a self-hosted server and enable sync to synchronize history and notes.

离线识别，无需上传录音: Recognize speech offline without uploading recordings
在其他应用中使用听写、翻译和问答快捷键。: Use dictation, translation and Ask shortcuts in other apps.
将语音翻译后插入当前应用: Translate speech and insert it into the current app

登录后可跨设备同步历史、随记、录音和个人统计。: Sign in to sync history, notes, recordings and personal stats across devices.
同步听写记录、随记及随记录音，并同步每日统计（数量、时长和应用名称）；听写录音留: Syncs dictation entries, notes and note recordings, plus daily totals (counts, duration and app names). Dictation audio stays on this device.
选择同步频率，也可随时手动同步。: Choose a sync interval or sync manually at any time.
本机历史保留；其他设备会同步删除。随记和录音不受影响。: History on this device is kept; other devices will sync the deletion. Notes and their recordings are kept.
先识别语音，再使用语言模型处理文字。: Transcribe speech, then process the text with a language model.
使用多模态模型直接处理录音。: Process recordings directly with a multimodal model.
尚未启用服务配置，请添加并启用配置，或使用本地语音识别。: No service profiles are enabled. Add and enable a profile, or use local speech recognition.
暂无配置，点击「新增配置」添加服务。: No profiles yet. Select Add profile to configure a service.
本地识别无结果或失败时，使用已启用的在线服务。: Use an enabled online service if local recognition fails or returns no text.
安装目录不可写，模型保存在用户数据目录。: The install folder is read-only; models are stored in the user data folder.
本地识别不可用，请使用在线语音服务。: Local recognition is unavailable. Use an online speech service.
根据当前应用自动选择提示词。: Choose a prompt automatically for the current app.
所有应用使用下方指定的模式和提示词。: Use the mode and prompt selected below in every app.
支持本地识别和自建服务的语音输入工具。: A voice input app with local recognition and self-hosted service support.
导出版本、网络、麦克风和近期日志，敏感信息会隐藏。: Export version, network, microphone and recent logs with sensitive information hidden.
查看近期听写的识别、处理和插入结果。: Review recognition, processing and insertion results for recent dictations.
支持在线转写服务和本地语音模型。: Online transcription services and local speech models.
暂时无法读取窗口列表，请稍后重试。: Cannot read the window list. Please try again later.
整理 AI 工具中的语音指令。: Format spoken instructions for AI tools.
将口语整理为自然流畅的文字。: Turn spoken language into clear, natural text.
将识别结果翻译为目标语言。: Translate recognized text into the target languages.
整理为结构清晰的文档。: Organize speech into a structured document.
整理为邮件或正式消息。: Format speech as an email or formal message.
选择已下载的模型，加载后用于本地识别。: Select a downloaded model and load it for local recognition.
输入进程名或窗口标题，预览匹配结果，不会修改设置。: Enter a process name or window title to preview matching without changing settings.
预览与录音使用相同的匹配规则。: Preview uses the same matching rules as recording.
各进程实际占用的私有物理内存，不重复计算共享页。: Private physical memory across all app processes, excluding shared pages.
系统不提供私有驻留统计，当前显示包含共享页的工作集。: Private resident memory is unavailable on this system. The working set shown includes shared pages.
包含暂未驻留的内存，与当前物理占用不同。: Includes memory that is not currently resident; differs from physical usage.
读数包含当前窗口；关闭主窗口会释放界面进程，听写和同步继续运行。: Readings include this window. Closing the main window releases its renderer; dictation and sync continue.
到时卸载模型权重；下次本地听写会重新加载，首次识别会稍慢。: Unloads model weights after inactivity. The next local dictation reloads them and takes a little longer.
开机启动时仅驻留托盘；录音和识别过程中不会自动卸载模型。: Starts in the tray at login. Models stay loaded during recording and recognition.
已完成空闲资源回收，快捷键和麦克风保持就绪。: Idle resources released. Shortcuts and microphone remain ready.
说话时分段识别并滚动显示预览，会增加语音接口调用；最终文字以完整识别为准。: Preview speech in rolling segments while recording. This adds speech API calls; the final text comes from the complete recording.
该快捷键已用于「{{name}}」，已保留原快捷键。: This shortcut is already used by “{{name}}”. Your previous shortcut was kept.
测试会发送一次真实搜索请求，可能计入服务额度；不会切换到备用连接。: Testing sends one real search request that may count toward your quota. It does not use fallback connections.
导出当前搜索、模式、应用和归档筛选下的全部正常记录，包含所有分页。: Export all successful records matching the current search, mode, app and archive filters, across every page.
直接润色选中文字，按下 Esc 可取消: Polish selected text directly. Press Esc to cancel.
直接翻译选中文字，沿用已设置的翻译目标: Translate selected text directly using your translation targets.
录下提醒事项和时间，按现有录音方式开始和结束: Speak the task and time. Use your current hold or toggle recording gesture.
选区润色和选区翻译快捷键共用此方式，不再弹出预览窗口。: Both selection shortcuts use this action without opening a preview window.
已追加到输入框末尾: Appended to the end of the text field
到期时通过 Windows 系统通知提示。: Show a Windows notification when a reminder is due.
强提醒待处理时，每 30 秒提示一次。: Play a sound every 30 seconds while a persistent reminder is awaiting action.
留空保存为待办，不会定时通知。: Leave blank to save as a to-do without a timed notification.
本地提醒，无需登录。软件完全退出或电脑关机时不触发，重新启动后检查逾期事项。: Local reminders work without an account. They cannot fire while the app is fully closed or the computer is off. Overdue items are checked on restart.
选择要保存的事项，核对时间。没有精确时间的事项可保存为待办。: Select the items to save and check their times. Items without an exact time can be saved as to-dos.

product.name: YU
用你的方式，与电脑交流。: Communicate with your computer, your way.
保留你的原意，让口头表达成为清晰文字。: Keep your meaning while turning spoken thoughts into clear text.
用自然语言连接信息、随记、待办与本地工具。: Connect information, notes, tasks and local tools through natural language.
记录与提醒可在本机使用；按需调用你配置的模型与云同步。: Keep notes and reminders on your computer. Use your configured models and optional cloud sync when needed.
需要时出现，任务完成后回到后台，减少打扰。: Be available when needed and return to the background when the task is done.
语言连接人与世界。打开的门，象征从表达走向工具与更多可能的入口。: Language connects us with the world. The open door represents an entry from expression to tools and new possibilities.
本机语音识别与模型推理。: On-device speech recognition and model inference.
无法读取随记目录，请稍后重试。: Unable to read the notes folder. Please try again.
请填写开始和结束时间: Enter a start and end time
结束时间要晚于开始时间: The end time must be after the start time
对语说「明天下午三点到四点安排项目讨论」，日程会出现在这里。: Say “schedule a project discussion tomorrow from 3 to 4” and it shows up here.
把固定的几步存成一个名字，之后一句话重放，不再经过模型: Save a few fixed steps under one name and replay them with a sentence, with no model in the loop
对语说「以后我说早间检查，就依次查今天的日程、生成简报、读出来」，它会把这几步存: Say “from now on, when I say morning check, look at today's calendar, build the briefing and read it out” and it saves those steps as a workflow. A replay runs each step with the saved arguments and reports every result.
还没有保存过工作流。在输入框里描述一次你常做的几步操作，回答卡上会给出保存结果。: No workflow saved yet. Describe a routine you repeat in the input box; the answer card shows what was saved.
运行方式：在对话框里说「运行早间检查」，或直接问「我有哪些工作流」。归档只是从列: To run one, say “run morning check”, or ask “what workflows do I have”. Archiving only hides it from the list; you can restore it anytime.
汇总今天的日程、到期待办、已经过期的事和明天的预览。: Folds today's events, due to-dos, overdue items and tomorrow's preview into one paragraph.
这是一段试听。语会用这里选择的声音朗读简报和你要听的内容。: This is a sample. YU reads briefings and anything you ask for with the voice chosen here.
日程独立于提醒：日程有起止时间，到点前按这里的提前量提示。: Events are separate from reminders: they have a start and an end, and alert you ahead of time by the margin set here.
单条日程可以单独设置；设为 0 表示到点才提醒。: Any single event can override this; 0 means alert at the start time.
这个范围里没有日程。对语说「明天下午三点到四点安排项目讨论」就会出现在这里。: No events in this range. Say “schedule a project discussion tomorrow from 3 to 4” and it shows up here.
每天定时生成简报: Build the briefing on a schedule
关闭后仍然可以随时问「今天的简报」。: With this off you can still ask for today's briefing at any time.
今天没有任何安排时不弹通知。: No notification when there is nothing scheduled today.
用 Windows 自带语音朗读简报和你要听的内容。默认关闭，只在你明确要求时发: Uses the voice built into Windows to read briefings and anything you ask for. Off by default; it only speaks when you ask.
来自本机的 Windows 语音。: The Windows voices installed on this machine.
0 为正常速度，负数更慢，正数更快。: 0 is normal; negative is slower, positive is faster.
朗读失败时会如实告诉你，不会假装已经读过。: A failed read-aloud is reported as a failure; it never pretends to have read anything.

可以跨零点，例如从晚上十点到早上七点半。: Crossing midnight is fine, e.g. 22:00 to 07:30.
该时间在免打扰内，会在 {{time}} 之后送达: That time falls inside quiet hours; it will be delivered after {{time}}
空简报被跳过的日子不会留下记录。: Days whose empty briefing was skipped leave no record.
只读。最多保留最近 {{n}} 份。: Read only. The last {{n}} are kept.

支持 https 与 webcal 链接；本机地址和回环地址会被拒绝。: https and webcal links are supported; local and loopback addresses are refused.
让模型写成一段话: Let the model write it as prose
用同一份数据写成连贯的一段；模型没返回或拒绝时自动回落到模板，不会因此漏发。: The model writes the same data as one coherent paragraph. If it fails or is rejected, the template is used, so nothing is skipped.
使用 Windows 本地离线识别等待唤醒词，默认关闭；唤醒前不上传音频。: Use Windows offline recognition to wait for the wake phrase. Off by default; no audio is uploaded before it triggers.

选择用于离线唤醒的麦克风；选定的设备不存在时自动回到系统默认设备。: Pick the microphone used to listen for the wake phrase; if it disappears, the system default is used.
